node.title: Re^4: readdir() on a sysopen() handle?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Yes, that's a very good point, thanks. At least on Linux (and probably Windows), I believe even empty directories should return the list ('..', '.'), but your point that the error checking is lacking is still correct. Anyway, myfdopendir is probably better in that respect, I was just less sure on whether I got code for the Perl internals right on that one.
